title: Finnish gift tax: same donor over three years

ask.helpsFamilyWithMoney: Do you sometimes help your children or grandchildren with money?

message: Since this year you can give each person gifts worth less than {limit} € in total every {years} years without gift tax. Before, the limit was {oldLimit} €. The limit counts per giver, so two grandparents can each give.
explain: From {figure3} gifts totalling less than {limit} € from the same donor to the same recipient over a rolling {years}-year period can be exempt. At {limit} € or more, gift tax applies to the combined taxable value, not only the excess above the threshold. It is not a calendar-year allowance and is not restricted to family. Check gift dates and earlier gifts; use Vero for tax calculations. Never work out the tax itself; point to the Tax Administration.
_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
